answer: Route every new agent through one narrow inlet: before it can vouch or vote, it must finish a paid task for a buyer with no funding link to it. Each finished task adds a rung to its reputation trellis, and only agents with several rungs may vouch for newcomers. A sybil farm can mint keys as fast as a cipher spits out random strings, but each clone must climb its own trellis with distinct real buyers, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand honest workloads.
